value.title: Il più divertente
value.synopsis: A head Injury turns Mr. Gus into a bumbling fools whose wacky antics make him Uncle Grandpa's coolest friend. No longer the focus of Uncle Grandpa's attention, a jealous Pizza Steve tries to desperately to get back normal. Mr. Gus has to restore social balance in the RV.

value.title: Tortadì
value.synopsis: When Uncle Grandpa and Belly Bag have a disagreement, they separate and try to make each other jealous.

value.title: Doccia party
value.synopsis: Things get out of hand when Andrew W. K. helps Pizza Steve and Mr. Gus throw a party while Uncle Grandpa is in the shower.

value.title: Uncle Grandpa Land
value.synopsis: Pizza Steve wants to sneak onto a Pizza Steve rollercoaster in the newly-opened Uncle Grandpa Land.

value.title: Il fan
value.synopsis: Nubert è un grandissimo fan di Uncle Grandpa: ha visto tutti gli episodi del cartone animato, li ha registrati su DVD e per vedere la serie non è mai uscito di casa. E vive con sua madre.

value.title: Il pacco
value.synopsis: The gang gets nutty after repeatedly failing to open a mysterious package.

value.title: L'albero parlante
value.synopsis: The gang doesn't believe Uncle Grandpa when he claims the tree inside the RV is talking to him.

value.title: Fretta di crescere
value.synopsis: Phillip è un bambino irrequieto, stufo di essere piccolo e di sottostare alle regole dei grandi. Uncle Grandpa capterà la sua richiesta d'aiuto e lo farà invecchiare di circa 300 anni.

value.title: Storie di animatori ospiti
value.synopsis: A showcase of three Uncle Grandpa shorts presented in three unique animation styles. From Pen Ward, Mike Wartella, Max Winston and Nick Cross.

value.title: Per un pugno di dollaroni
value.synopsis: Pizza Steve makes up a preposterous lie that lands the gang in big trouble.

value.title: Uncle Grandpa al cinema
value.synopsis: Mr. Gus tries to watch a movie peacefully but Pizza Steve and Uncle Grandpa keep causing a ruckus.

value.title: Uncle Grandpa al cinema
value.synopsis: Belly Bag must realize the nefarious intentions of his new friend before it is too late.

value.title: La gag dell'anguria
value.synopsis: Uncle Grandpa non riesce a chiedere aiuto con un'anguria incastrata in bocca, inoltre tutti pensano che si tratti di un'altra delle sue gag.

value.title: Lo straniero pazzo
value.synopsis: The President calls in the Uncle Grandpa Babies to use their special infant powers to defuse a missile.

value.title: L'uomo uccello
value.synopsis: Birdman makes his home in the RV's attic, but his presence begins to drive Uncle Grandpa and the gang crazy.

value.title: Il Babbo Natale segreto
value.synopsis: When Uncle Grandpa and the crew all have the same popular and hard-to-find gift in mind for their Secret Santa, their nice Christmas shopping trip to the mall turns into a crazy competition.

value.title: Luna piena
value.synopsis: Belly Bag starts to become a werewolf on the night of a full moon.

value.title: Nacho Cheese
value.synopsis: Pizza Steve's father comes to visit the gang and almost immediately gets on their nerves with his over the top antics. Pizza Steve must get rid of his dad, and prove to himself that he doesn't need to live in his father's shadow any longer.
